intent: The multi-line text field an InputGroup frames, drawn without chrome of its own.
typical_uses: The field of an InputGroup with a full-width addon row above or below it

dont_use_when.situation: A multi-line field with no InputGroup around it

invariants.text: `value` and `defaultValue` are both accepted; `defaultValue` seeds the initial state and is ignored afterwards, and when `value` is given it wins and the component follows it on every render.

Inside an InputGroup the textarea's own border, background, radius and focus or invalid ring are removed, the resize handle is turned off, and it stretches to fill the row; its `:focus-visible`, `aria-invalid="true"` and `:disabled` states are what the surrounding group draws.
While the textarea is a direct child of the group, the group aligns its addons to the top of the row instead of its middle, and the group grows with the textarea past its size floor.

a11y.by: input-group.test.tsx resolves the field by getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message' }) from its aria-label, and asserts that clicking a block-start addon moves document.activeElement to it

good.title: Message field with a recipient row above it

bad.title: Initial text passed as children
bad.why: A textarea takes its text from `defaultValue` or `value`; React only falls back to children with a warning, and throws beside `defaultValue`.
